sections.heading: Part I — Student-Produced Response Questions (SPRs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of the linear function \(f\) is shown. What is the value of \(f(2)\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(-6\). Read the graph at \(x = 2\): the line passes through \((2, -6)\), so \(f(2) = -6\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: What is the positive \(x\)-intercept of the graph of \(y = x^2 + 3x - 4\) in the \(xy\)-plane?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(1\). Setting \(y = 0\): \((x - 1)(x + 4) = 0\), so \(x = 1\) or \(x = -4\). The positive intercept is 1.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: What is the positive \(x\)-intercept of the graph of \(y = x^2 + x - 6\) in the \(xy\)-plane?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(2\). Setting \(y = 0\): \((x - 2)(x + 3) = 0\), so \(x = 2\) or \(x = -3\). The positive intercept is 2.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graphs of \(y = x\) and \(y = -x - 2\) intersect at the point \((a, b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the value of \(a\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(-1\). Set the expressions equal: \(x = -x - 2\), giving \(2x = -2\) and \(a = -1\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graphs of \(y = 4x - 2\) and \(y = -2x + 16\) intersect at the point \((a, b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the value of \(a\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(3\). Set the expressions equal: \(4x - 2 = -2x + 16\), giving \(6x = 18\) and \(a = 3\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graphs of \(y = x + 3\) and \(y = -3x + 7\) intersect at the point \((a, b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the value of \(a\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(1\). Set the expressions equal: \(x + 3 = -3x + 7\), giving \(4x = 4\) and \(a = 1\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graphs of \(y = 4x\) and \(y = -3x - 21\) intersect at the point \((a, b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the value of \(a\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(-3\). Set the expressions equal: \(4x = -3x - 21\), giving \(7x = -21\) and \(a = -3\).

sections.heading: Part I — Student-Produced Response Questions (SPRs): Intermediate Application (8–14)

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = (x - h)^2 + k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants, is shown. What is the value of \(h + k\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(1\). The vertex of the parabola shown is \((0, 1)\), so \(h = 0\), \(k = 1\), and \(h + k = 1\).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 2(x-6) = 3x-5 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -7. Distribute: \( 2x-12 = 3x-5 \). \( -x = -5 + 12 \Rightarrow x=-7 \).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = 2(x - h)^2 + k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants, is shown. What is the value of \(h + k\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(-2\). The vertex of the parabola shown is \((0, -2)\), so \(h = 0\), \(k = -2\), and \(h + k = -2\).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}x+6y=-43\\-x-y=13\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( y \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -6. Adding the equations eliminates \( x \): \( 5y=-30 \Rightarrow y=-6 \). Then \( x=-7 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: \[ \begin{cases}6x-3y=-6\\-6x+5y=-2\end{cases} \] What is the value of \( y \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -4. Adding the equations eliminates \( x \): \( 2y=-8 \Rightarrow y=-4 \). Then \( x=-3 \).

questions.target: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations
questions.q: If \( 3(x-2) = -3x-12 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** -1. Distribute: \( 3x-6 = -3x-12 \). \( 6x = -12 + 6 \Rightarrow x=-1 \).

questions.q: If \( 2x+5 = -5x+47 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 6. Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, \( 7x = 47 - 5 \Rightarrow x = 6 \) Therefore, the verified correct option is 6.
questions.explanation: Applying Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles, \( 7x = 47 - 5 \Rightarrow x = 6 \) Therefore, the verified correct option is 6.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 6y - 39 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(8\). Completing the square: \((x - 4)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 64\), so the radius is 8.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = (x + 4)(x - 3)\) intersects the \(x\)-axis at the points \((p, 0)\) and \((q, 0)\). What is the value of \(q - p\), where \(q > p\)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(7\). The \(x\)-intercepts are -4 and 3, so \(q - p = 3 - (-4) = 7\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 + 10x - 2y - 38 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(8\). Completing the square: \((x + 5)^2 + (y - 1)^2 = 64\), so the radius is 8.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 + 4x + 2y - 59 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(8\). Completing the square: \((x + 2)^2 + (y + 1)^2 = 64\), so the radius is 8.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 10y - 23 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(8\). Completing the square: \((x - 4)^2 + (y + 5)^2 = 64\), so the radius is 8.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Foundational Fluency (21–28)

questions.q: The graph of the linear function \( f \) is shown. What is the slope of the graph of \( y = f(x) \)?
questions.answer: The line passes through \( (0, -3) \) and \( (2, 3) \), so its slope is \( \frac{3 - (-3)}{2 - 0} = 3 \).

questions.q: In this problem, the graph of the linear function \( f \) is shown. What is the slope of the graph of \( y = f(x) \)?
questions.answer: The line passes through \( (0, -2) \) and \( (2, 2) \), so its slope is \( \frac{2 - (-2)}{2 - 0} = 2 \).

questions.q: Observe that the graph of the linear function \( f \) is shown. What is the slope of the graph of \( y = f(x) \)?
questions.answer: The line passes through \( (0, 4) \) and \( (2, 0) \), so its slope is \( \frac{0 - (4)}{2 - 0} = -2 \).

questions.q: Suppose the graph of the linear function \( f \) is shown. What is the slope of the graph of \( y = f(x) \)?
questions.answer: The line passes through \( (0, -1) \) and \( (2, 3) \), so its slope is \( \frac{3 - (-1)}{2 - 0} = 2 \).

questions.q: What is the positive \( x \)-intercept of the graph of \( y = x^2 - x - 6 \) in the \( xy \)-plane?
questions.answer: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( (x - 3)(x + 2) = 0 \), so \( x = 3 \) or \( x = -2 \). The positive intercept is 3.

questions.q: The graphs of \( y = 3x \) and \( y = -x + 8 \) intersect at the point \( (a, b) \) in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the value of \( a \)?
questions.answer: Set the expressions equal: \( 3x = -x + 8 \), giving \( 4x = 8 \) and \( a = 2 \).

questions.q: The graphs of \( y = x - 3 \) and \( y = -3x + 13 \) intersect at the point \( (a, b) \) in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the value of \( a \)?
questions.answer: Set the expressions equal: \( x - 3 = -3x + 13 \), giving \( 4x = 16 \) and \( a = 4 \).

questions.q: The graphs of \( y = 2x + 5 \) and \( y = -x + 17 \) intersect at the point \( (a, b) \) in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the value of \( a \)?
questions.answer: Set the expressions equal: \( 2x + 5 = -x + 17 \), giving \( 3x = 12 \) and \( a = 4 \).

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Intermediate Application (29–37)

questions.q: What is the positive \( x \)-intercept of the graph of \( y = x^2 - 4 \) in the \( xy \)-plane?
questions.answer: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( (x - 2)(x + 2) = 0 \), so \( x = 2 \) or \( x = -2 \). The positive intercept is 2.

questions.q: The graphs of \( y = 4x - 2 \) and \( y = -x + 8 \) intersect at the point \( (a, b) \) in the \( xy \)-plane. What is the value of \( a \)?
questions.answer: Set the expressions equal: \( 4x - 2 = -x + 8 \), giving \( 5x = 10 \) and \( a = 2 \).

questions.q: Calculate the value corresponding to the positive \( x \)-intercept of the graph of \( y = x^2 - x - 12 \) in the \( xy \)-plane?
questions.answer: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( (x - 4)(x + 3) = 0 \), so \( x = 4 \) or \( x = -3 \). The positive intercept is 4.

questions.q: If \( 6(x+1) = -x+20 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 2. Distribute: \( 6x+6 = -x+20 \). \( 7x = 20 - 6 \Rightarrow x=2 \).

questions.q: What is the sum of all solutions to \( |3x - 9| = 15 \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 6. Two cases: \( 3x - 9 = 15 \implies 3x = 24 \implies x = 8 \); and \( 3x - 9 = -15 \implies 3x = -6 \implies x = -2 \). The sum of solutions is \( 8 + (-2) = 6 \).
questions.explanation: Two cases: \( 3x - 9 = 15 \implies 3x = 24 \implies x = 8 \); and \( 3x - 9 = -15 \implies 3x = -6 \implies x = -2 \). The sum of solutions is \( 8 + (-2) = 6 \).

What is the positive solution to \( |2x - 4| = 12 \)?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 8. \( 2x - 4 = 12 \implies 2x = 16 \implies x = 8 \). (The negative solution is \( 2x - 4 = -12 \implies x = -4 \)).

A two-digit number has a tens digit \( t \) and a units digit \( u \). The sum of the digits is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 greater than the original. What was the original number?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 47. \( t + u = 11 \) and \( (10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t = 3 \). Adding equations gives \( 2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t = 4 \). Original number is 47.
questions.explanation: \( t + u = 11 \) and \( (10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t = 3 \). Adding equations gives \( 2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t = 4 \). Original number is 47.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Challenging Synthesis (38–45)

questions.q: A farmer has chickens and cows. In total, there are 30 heads and 84 legs. How many cows does the farmer have?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 12. Let \( c \) be chickens and \( w \) be cows. \( c + w = 30 \implies 2c + 2w = 60 \). Legs: \( 2c + 4w = 84 \). Subtract: \( 2w = 24 \implies w = 12 \).
questions.explanation: Let \( c \) be chickens and \( w \) be cows. \( c + w = 30 \implies 2c + 2w = 60 \). Legs: \( 2c + 4w = 84 \). Subtract: \( 2w = 24 \implies w = 12 \).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = (x + 4)(x - 2)\) intersects the \(x\)-axis at the points \((p, 0)\) and \((q, 0)\). What is the value of \(q - p\), where \(q > p\)?
questions.answer: The \(x\)-intercepts are -4 and 2, so \(q - p = 2 - (-4) = 6\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 + 4x - 6y - 23 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: Completing the square: \((x + 2)^2 + (y - 3)^2 = 36\), so the radius is 6.

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = (x + 2)(x - 1)\) intersects the \(x\)-axis at the points \((p, 0)\) and \((q, 0)\). What is the value of \(q - p\), where \(q > p\)?
questions.answer: The \(x\)-intercepts are -2 and 1, so \(q - p = 1 - (-2) = 3\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 8y - 39 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: Completing the square: \((x - 3)^2 + (y + 4)^2 = 64\), so the radius is 8.

questions.q: A store sells notebooks for $3 each and pens for $1.50 each. Maria spent $18 on a total of 8 items. How many notebooks did she buy?
questions.answer: **Answer:** 4. Let \( n \) = notebooks: \( 3n+1.5(8-n)=18 \Rightarrow 1.5n=6 \Rightarrow n=4 \).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The graph of \(y = -(x)(x - 1)\) intersects the \(x\)-axis at the points \((p, 0)\) and \((q, 0)\). What is the value of \(q - p\), where \(q > p\)?
questions.answer: The \(x\)-intercepts are 0 and 1, so \(q - p = 1 - (0) = 1\).

questions.target: Graphing Intersections, Slider Constants & Desmos Modeling
questions.q: The equation \(x^2 + y^2 - 2x - 3 = 0\) defines a circle in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: Completing the square: \((x - 1)^2 + (y)^2 = 4\), so the radius is 2.
